brief:
Israeli occupation forces issued demolition notices Monday for memorial billboards and monuments bearing images of killed Palestinians in Jenin city and Yabad village, southwest of the governorate, Shehab Wire reported. Security sources said the notices targeted multiple commemorative structures displaying photographs of deceased resistance fighters.

The removals are part of a broader Israeli practice of eliminating public displays honoring Palestinians killed in the conflict.

title: Israeli forces order removal of martyrs' memorial signs in Jenin
